intro.text: A thin, timid woman in New Seran who lives with Templeton Fig.

items.text: Destra lives with Templeton Fig, apparently as his partner, but he does not treat her as his equal, which seems to be part of why she is so nervous around him.

appearance.text: Thin to the point of looking skeletal; she has lost a good deal of weight lately and her clothes no longer fit.
